title: Topic 9
japanese_text: 5年前に祖母は<u>他界して</u>しまった。しかし、今でも盆や正月には<u>親族</u><u>一同</u>集まって、祖母の<u>生前</u>の話をして盛り上がっており、<u>いかに</u>祖母がみんなに愛されていたかが分かる。
english_translation: My grandmother passed away five years ago. However, all my relatives still get together at Obon in summer and at New Year's to talk about her life and have a good time. It shows how much my grandmother was loved by everyone.
